outcome: A durable, application-owned feedback episode lifecycle turns grounded finding input into an authorized response and a fresh measured outcome, ending in an explicit FeedbackResolution.
currentProblem: BB-083 research mixed the per-episode feedback lifecycle with observation productization and cross-episode self-improvement. The lifecycle itself needs only grounded observation input and application authority; it must not wait on optimizer, benchmark or HOW promotion semantics.
constraints: Additive only: BB-083 and all other existing objectives, plans, readiness and scope remain unchanged.
Consumes only the BB-084 GroundedFindingInput contract; research may use the BB-084 desired state, the Worker binds only DONE BB-084 exports.
Observation, finding, disposition and outcome authority remain separate; observer, evaluator, provider or optimizer fields can never supply the application principal.
The lifecycle ends at FeedbackResolution; cross-episode pattern, reinforcement, optimizer and promotion belong to Self-Improve.
Missing, stale or unresolved evidence stays UNKNOWN or unresolved and is never converted to success.
successCriteria: Specify an immutable FeedbackEpisode whose finding and MEASURED or HYPOTHESIZED impact bind exact BB-084 GroundedFindingInput refs, scope key and contrary evidence; unresolved input cannot yield MEASURED impact or ACTED.

Specify application-owned ACTED/REJECTED/DEFERRED/SUPERSEDED responses with verified principal, expected-revision CAS, idempotent replay and crash recovery; observer, evaluator and provider cannot act as principal.
Specify fresh IMPROVED/NO_CHANGE/REGRESSED/UNKNOWN outcomes bound to a frozen outcome policy and explicit freshness identity newer than the response; UNKNOWN is never success.
Specify FeedbackResolution as the terminal lifecycle boundary with no cross-episode aggregation, optimizer, benchmark or promotion dependency.
Produce an exact package/file-level implementation plan, direct dependencies, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.
